# Scnr

> Scnr makes dynamic QR codes with real-time scan analytics. Print a code once, then change where it points any time without reprinting. Built for restaurants and small businesses in Sri Lanka, with plans priced in LKR and USD.

## Pages

- [Home](https://scnr.tharkak.com/): product overview, features and pricing (Free, Pro, Team and Business plans)
- [Free tools](https://scnr.tharkak.com/tools): index of the free tools, no sign-in needed
- [QR code scanner](https://scnr.tharkak.com/tools/qr-scanner): read a QR code with a camera or a photo
- [UTM link builder](https://scnr.tharkak.com/tools/utm-builder): add utm tags to a link
- [Google review link](https://scnr.tharkak.com/tools/google-review-link): make a direct review link from a Place ID
- [WhatsApp link maker](https://scnr.tharkak.com/tools/whatsapp-link): make a click-to-chat link
- [Free QR generator](https://scnr.tharkak.com/tools/qr-generator): make a static QR code, PNG or SVG
- [What's new](https://scnr.tharkak.com/whats-new): release notes for customers
- [Privacy Policy](https://scnr.tharkak.com/legal/privacy-policy)
- [Terms and Conditions](https://scnr.tharkak.com/legal/terms-and-conditions)
- [Refund Policy](https://scnr.tharkak.com/legal/refund-policy)
